overview.Name: DiamondRock Hospitality Company
overview.Description: DiamondRock Hospitality Company is a self-advised real estate investment trust (REIT) that is an owner of a leading portfolio of geographically diversified hotels concentrated in leisure destinations and top gateway markets. The Company currently owns 34 premium quality hotels with 9,400 rooms. The Company has strategically positioned its portfolio to be operated both under leading global brand families as well as independent boutique hotels in the lifestyle segment. DiamondRock Hospitality Company was established on May 26 2004 and is based in Bethesda, United States.
